findings.title: Toolbar: sticky note tool is hard to discover
findings.observation: The participant searched the toolbar and drew a rectangle before typing the idea inside it.
findings.hypothesis: The intended note tool may be difficult to discover in the toolbar.

evidence.quote: I need to add a few ideas to this board, but I do not immediately see how to add a note.

limitations: One simulated fixture session; alternative explanations remain.
findings.suggested_experiment: Surface the note tool in the main toolbar with a clear label.
